os-dev-report

Card thread session `session_01L6bhgX6EQZ4fi7BLKzhfLT`, branch `claude/project-thread-ngbinh` (claim 6661798960; the seat names the branch in its amendment), base `8e5fabe5`, `main` merged in after PR #30540 landed. Draft PR #30575, head `4a1e9138` (code `f6ce715a`; two evidence commits add and remove eight PNGs, net zero; then the merge of `main`, no conflict).

**Delivered.** A `toggle` whose specifier declares `confirmOffText` asks before it goes off: the switch going from on to off opens a confirmation with the text, resolved through `settings.NAMESPACE.keys.KEY.confirmOffText` (manifest literal on a miss; an inline locale map literal is picked for the page language). Cancel keeps the switch on and drafts nothing, so nothing can be saved; Continue drafts `false` and the page's Save sends it. Turning on asks nothing; a toggle without the key is unchanged. The dialog reuses the `actionConfirm.*` keys of the `action_button` confirmation: no locale key, no export.

**Live, Setup > Authentication, `email_password_enabled`** (showcase `objectstack dev --seed-admin`, branch console under vite, Playwright): en-US and zh-CN both ask (zh-CN shows the server's zh text); Cancel keeps it on with no unsaved bar; Continue then Save is refused `400 SETTINGS_VALIDATION` by the server's last-sign-in-method floor when nothing else is configured, and saved `200` with Google sign-in set in the same save. Before (the guard ablated live): one click turned it off with no question. Screenshots are in the PR body.

## 席位核对 · Amendment · 2026-11-05T16:38Z · claim 6661798960 corrected

Metadata-protocol: none

The claim's `semantic` was this seat's error. AGENTS.md §3 and the "WHICH LEVEL" text of `.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml` read Metadata-protocol as the change to what a metadata author can write, and name the console as `none`. PR #30575 changes no spec file: `SpecifierSchema.confirmOffText` already meant "Confirm dialog text shown before a toggle's value changes to off" (PR #30489), and the console now honours it. So the changeset is `patch` on `@object-ui/console`; the card thread corrected it at head `e88fef3c`, and the seat corrected the PR body. Everything else in claim 6661798960 and its branch amendment 6661889348 stands.
